one_liner: Jira Cloud is a SaaS project management and work tracking platform for software teams to plan, track, and manage their work.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) uses authorization code grants. JWT authentication is built into Connect app libraries. Basic auth uses API tokens (email + token). Forge apps use OAuth 2.0 with scopes.

evidence.snippet: For integrations that are not Forge or Connect apps, use OAuth 2.0 authorization code grants (3LO) for security
For Connect apps, authentication (JWT-based) is built into the Connect libraries.
For personal scripts, bots, and ad-hoc execution of the REST APIs use basic authentication.
You generate an API token for your Atlassian account and use it to authenticate anywhere where you would have used a password.

access.notes: Pages document OAuth and API token authentication methods and mention free tier exists, but do not explicitly state whether API access is available on free tier instances or describe the process to obtain a Jira Cloud instance.

evidence.snippet: Customer edition: In the Per-Tenant Pool, Free, Standard, Premium, or Enterprise and the number of users.
Sign in to the [Atlassian developer console](https://developer.atlassian.com/console/myapps) (create a developer account if you don't have one).

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Jira enforces three independent rate limiting systems: points-based hourly quota, burst per-second limits, and per-issue write limits. Points-based quotas vary by customer edition and tier (Global Pool default or Per-Tenant Pool).

evidence.snippet: version 3 of the Jira Cloud platform REST API, which is the latest version.
The same points system applies to both REST and GraphQL APIs.
A webhook is a user-defined callback over HTTPS. You can use Jira webhooks to notify your app or web application when certain events occur in
Jira Cloud enforces three independent rate limiting systems that work simultaneously to protect platform stability.

buildability.rationale: API is well-documented with REST and GraphQL, webhooks, rate limiting guidance, and multiple auth options; Composio toolkit with 171 tools already published.

overview_evidence.snippet: Jira Cloud is built for every member of your software team to plan, track, and manage their work.
The Jira REST API enables you to interact with Jira programmatically to build apps, script interactions, or develop integrations.
